method.name: limited curated portfolio search with hourly merit dispatch and greedy daily battery arbitrage (V2 rules)
limitations: Candidate set is intentionally limited (14 base portfolios x 4 battery sizes); batteries use a greedy daily arbitrage heuristic, not an optimizer, and do not help avoid unserved demand.
No detailed unit commitment, startup, ramping, outage, or gas-delivery constraints.
Benchmark outputs are screening estimates, not certified uptime or project economics.

metrics.accounting_basis: Undiscounted sum of annualized-capacity screening charges and energy/response costs; not project NPV. Fixed horizon month0..120. Constant 2023 USD; repeated historical year with merchant wholesale, Henry Hub gas and grid/remote CO2 on the real-terms path in data/price_trajectory.json; screening scenario, not a forecast.
metrics.comparison_note: Show timing and requested/interrupted MWh with costs. Later service delivers less electricity within the fixed horizon; cheaper total alone does not establish a better outcome. Primary100kg threshold uses combined_electricity_co2_kg_per_mwh.
